subject.title: 飞书消息回复引用(replyTo)有时不显示 - OpenClaw 2026.3.23-2

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt the open Feishu anchor PR for this issue, or authorize a smaller separate `replyTo` action-layer fix?
rationale: There is a clear source-backed Feishu plugin bug, but an overlapping proof-supplied PR is already open with merge-risk findings, so opening another automated fix branch would likely duplicate or conflict with that landing path.

options.title: Repair Existing Feishu Anchor PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 as the landing path after preserving current Feishu group/P2P invariants and resolving its conflicts.

options.title: Open Narrow Replacement
options.body: Close or pause the broad PR and sponsor a smaller credited replacement that only forwards explicit `replyTo` through the Feishu action layer plus focused tests.

options.title: Wait For Live Repro
options.body: Keep this issue open without new repair work until a Feishu-capable maintainer captures a current-main live run for the exact `replyTo` failure.

recommendation.title: Repair Existing Feishu Anchor PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 as the landing path after preserving current Feishu group/P2P invariants and resolving its conflicts.

likelyOwner.reason: The current gap is in Feishu action/media/card send handling, and vincentkoc authored recent merged work on that exact action surface.
